papers.title: Corrosion Behavior of Additive Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V Alloy in NaCl Solution
papers.first_author_affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, 430074, People’s Republic of China

corresponding_authors.name: Jingjing Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, 430074, People’s Republic of China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V在NaCl溶液中的腐蚀行为，但未涉及应力遮挡、多孔结构、疲劳或骨整合等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing, no porous structures, no fatigue analysis, no surface characterization relevant to osseointegration; focuses solely on corrosion electrochemistry.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V在生理环境中的腐蚀行为，评估其生物相容性。
summary_zh.method: 在NaCl溶液中进行电化学腐蚀测试，包括动电位极化和阻抗谱分析。
summary_zh.result: 增材制造试样表现出与锻造合金相似的腐蚀行为，但表面缺陷影响局部腐蚀。
summary_zh.validation: 通过电化学测试与显微观察验证腐蚀机制。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the corrosion behavior of additive manufactured Ti-6Al-4V in chloride-containing environments relevant to biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Electrochemical corrosion tests including potentiodynamic polarization and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy were performed in NaCl solution.
summary_en.result: Additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V exhibited corrosion resistance comparable to wrought alloy, but surface defects promoted localized corrosion.
summary_en.validation: Electrochemical measurements and microscopic analysis confirmed the corrosion mechanisms.
